name: Conall mac Luigthig
text: Conall mac Luigthig is an alternate designation for Corc mac Luigthig. The two names belong to one figure. The fuller account of his life sits in the PCE article on Corc mac Luigthic. See Corc mac Luigthic.

attributes.attribute: an alternate designation for Corc mac Luigthig

okr.objective: Conall mac Luigthig is an alias that points to Corc mac Luigthig.
key_results: MacKillop lists Conall mac Luigthig as a name of Corc mac Luigthig.
The two names denote one figure.
The main PCE article sits at Corc mac Luigthic.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Dictionary of Celtic Mythology, s.v. 'Conall mac Luigthig' (2008).
